<h2>Join Sample Ages</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Joins sample ages to records using dataset and sample identifiers.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>join_sample_ages(data_records = NULL, data_sample_ages = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_records">data_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame containing 'dataset_name' and 'sample_name'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_sample_ages">data_sample_ages</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame containing 'dataset_name', 'sample_name', and 'age'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The age table must have at most one row per dataset-sample key. Unmatched
records are retained with a missing age.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>'data_records' with the matching 'age' column joined.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_records &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    dataset_name = "example",
    sample_name = "sample_1",
    value = 10
  )
data_sample_ages &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    dataset_name = "example",
    sample_name = "sample_1",
    age = 100
  )

join_sample_ages(
  data_records = data_records,
  data_sample_ages = data_sample_ages
)
</code></pre>

</main>
